To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Spiritual healers are widely used in Nigeria, (2) they are consulted by people with mental health problems, (3) they are not adequately equipped to deal with these problems, and (4) they should be encouraged to refer patients with mental health problems to psychiatrists.
spiritual healers are widely perceived by their followers to have some knowledge of mental illness.
the healers are not ready to refer their clients to psychiatrists.

the following questions: 1) what are the mental health problems that bring clients to spiritual healers? 2) what are the spiritual healers' explanatory models of mental health problems? 3) what are the practices of spiritual healers in the management of mental health problems and what are the implications for the psychiatric profession?
